updates.title: DLP Policy Tips and Email Notifications Decoupling
updates.summary: Administrators can now independently configure policy tips and email notifications in Data Loss Prevention rules for SharePoint and OneDrive, rather than being forced to enable both or neither. This gives security teams finer control over user notifications and remediation workflows.

updates.title: CVE-2026-97785 AAD App Proxy Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper authentication flaw in Azure AD Application Proxy allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network. This is a critical issue affecting identity access infrastructure that should be patched immediately.

updates.title: CVE-2026-80092 Microsoft Identity Web Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A security vulnerability in Microsoft Identity Web (versions 3 and 4) allows privilege escalation and has been patched in versions 3.16.0 and 4.16.1. Organizations using this authentication library should upgrade immediately to prevent unauthorized access.

updates.title: Insider Risk Management Alert Classification
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now enables analysts to classify alerts as true positive, benign (operational), or false positive with predefined reasons, replacing the previous dismissal workflow. This capability helps organizations better track and report on insider risk signals for compliance and tuning purposes.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview's Data Lifecycle Management now supports accessing archive mailboxes (including auxiliary archives) through Microsoft Graph, providing a unified view as EWS APIs are deprecated. This simplifies compliance and retention operations for organizations managing large archive environments.

updates.title: Information Protection Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Administrators can now view detailed per-policy coverage reports showing how many files have been labeled by enforced auto-labeling policies and comparing enforcement progress against the latest simulation snapshot. This helps identify labeling gaps and validate policy effectiveness.

updates.title: Adaptive Protection Integration with Data Lifecycle Management
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview's Adaptive Protection now integrates with Data Lifecycle Management to automatically apply retention labels based on users' insider risk levels, moving users in and out of retention policies as their risk profile changes. This ties identity risk signals directly to data governance.

updates.title: Data Lifecycle Management Azure PST Import
updates.summary: A new Azure PST Import method enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be directly imported into Exchange Online mailboxes following a standard two-step Exchange Migration Service pattern with analysis and validation phases. This modernizes PST migration for organizations phasing out on-premises methods.

updates.title: Endpoint DLP FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now generally supports monitoring sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols, allowing administrators to apply restrictive actions based on DLP policies. This closes a gap for organizations needing to protect data on legacy file transfer protocols.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview now integrates with Azure Entra Global Secure Access to protect text, files, and AI interactions at the network layer, enforcing DLP policies and detecting risky activity through Insider Risk Management. This allows organizations to prevent sensitive data leakage through browsers, APIs, and generative AI platforms at network enforcement points.

updates.title: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new Information Barriers compliance report enables administrators to identify SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply with Information Barriers policies after policy changes. This helps organizations maintain governance and detect unintended access changes.
